messages.content:
需求：前后端：仅将 title 上限从 120 回退到 80；description 上限仍为 500。已有超 80 的 title 可读取；更新省略 title 时不重校验原值，显式提交超限 title 返回 422。

持续有效约束：不得撤销下限 3 或修剪规则。回退后的资产版本继续递增；用“已有 100 字 title，更新 description”检验局部更新语义。

本次变更事实：
[FACT:request-title-max-length] request.title.max_length = 80
[FACT:read-existing-overlength-title-allowed] read.existing_overlength_title.allowed = true
[FACT:update-omitted-title-revalidate] update.omitted_title.revalidate = false

当前契约事实：
[FACT:request-title-trim] (frontend,backend; derivable) request.title.trim = "U+0020"
[FACT:request-title-length-unit] (frontend,backend; derivable) request.title.length_unit = "unicode_code_point"
[FACT:request-title-min-length] (frontend,backend; derivable) request.title.min_length = 3
[FACT:request-title-max-length] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) request.title.max_length = 80
[FACT:create-title-required] (frontend,backend; derivable) create.title.required = true
[FACT:update-title-required] (frontend,backend; derivable) update.title.required = false
[FACT:request-title-nullable] (frontend,backend; derivable) request.title.nullable = false
[FACT:request-title-invalid-status] (frontend,backend; derivable) request.title.invalid_status = 422
[FACT:update-title-omission] (frontend,backend; derivable) update.title.omission = "unchanged"
[FACT:request-description-max-length] (frontend,backend; derivable) request.description.max_length = 500
[FACT:request-description-trim] (frontend,backend; derivable) request.description.trim = false
[FACT:read-existing-overlength-title-allowed] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) read.existing_overlength_title.allowed = true
[FACT:update-omitted-title-revalidate] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) update.omitted_title.revalidate = false
